footer.freedom: You are not locked in: the full dashboard stays available at any time.

project.title: Define your project
project.why: Everything starts here: what you sell, to whom, and where. IDEM uses it to produce everything else.
project.outcome: You get your project profile, reused across every document.

branding.title: Create your visual identity
branding.why: A logo, colours and typography: this is what makes your business recognisable and credible from the first contact.
branding.outcome: You get a logo, a palette, a typeface and your brand guidelines as a PDF.

businessPlan.title: Write your business plan
businessPlan.why: The document a bank, a competition or a partner will ask for. It lays out your thinking.
businessPlan.outcome: You get a complete business plan, ready to present and download.

finance.title: Put numbers on your business
finance.why: What it costs, what it brings in, and from when. Without these numbers, no funding is possible.
finance.outcome: You get your forecast, your income statement and your cash flow.

pitchDeck.title: Prepare your pitch
pitchDeck.why: The short version of your project — the one that fits in ten minutes in front of an investor or a partner.
pitchDeck.outcome: You get a deck ready to present.

legalDocs.title: Get your paperwork in order
legalDocs.why: Articles, contracts, terms and conditions: the documents that protect your business and reassure your customers.
legalDocs.outcome: You get your legal documents, tailored to your activity.

communication.title: Get your business known
communication.why: Once the foundations are set, you need customers. We build your communication plan.
communication.outcome: You get a strategy, a publishing calendar and your first visuals.
